`gate_decisions.record_gate_decision` now hard-refuses any gate not in `("1","2")`; existing callers recording gates 1.5/2.5 (documented in REVIEW-GATES-LIFECYCLE) will be silently refused — verify all call sites before merge.

`finalize_item.build` writes `"item_revision": revision + 1` speculatively, then `backlog.update` bumps revision again — the persisted report's revision is systematically off-by-one, undermining any future staleness check.
